name: Shijima Mei
source:
"You're pretty heated, Sensei... I'm getting pretty fired up too!"

In XR, the Beast King's behavior is still shrouded in mystery. So let's talk about her in reality. She is a "former" special student at Nijou Crane Academy. Her karate, which she had practiced since her childhood, was at a national competitive level. 
She had a promising future. Such a future is suddenly lost due to the aftereffects of a car accident. 
The path to become the strongest, her karate which she had devoted her life, and the oath she swore with her former sensei..... She also lost her position as a special student...… and it would be tactless to mention more. 
One thing I can say is that after her physical breakdown in reality, the only place she can go wild is in XR. 
Here are her words: "I will prove it. I will prove who is the 'strongest' in XR!"
Mei's will was inherited by her in-game avatar, the Beast King Mei. 
Today, too, she clenches her fist and heads to the battlefield to prove who is the strongest.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Beastman 
Height: 160 cm
Occupation: Beast King
